meta.name: lark-shared
meta.description: Use for lark-cli setup/auth tasks: auth login/status/logout, user vs bot identity, business-domain permissions (--domain, including all/docs/drive), missing scopes, revoking authorization, or handling _notice JSON.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在飞书开放平台进行命令行认证和权限管理
copy.tagline_en: Manage Lark CLI authentication and permissions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle Lark CLI auth and permissions

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你完成飞书 CLI 的配置、登录、权限管理、身份切换等操作，并处理授权链接和二维码。
howto.when: 当你需要配置飞书 CLI、登录/退出、检查权限、处理授权错误或管理身份时触发。

say.text: 帮我用飞书 CLI 登录，获取所有权限。
say.note: Claude 会执行 auth login 并生成二维码。

say.text: 检查当前飞书 CLI 的登录状态。
用 bot 身份查看日历。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you configure, log in, manage permissions, switch identities for Lark CLI, and handle authorization links and QR codes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to configure Lark CLI, log in/out, check permissions, handle authorization errors, or manage identities.

say_en.text: Help me log in to Lark CLI with all permissions.
say_en.note: Claude will run auth login and generate a QR code.

say_en.text: Check the current login status of Lark CLI.
say_en.note: Claude will run auth status and return identity info.
Claude will run as bot; note bot cannot see user's calendar.
